pieces.Text: If you have performed your daily obedience, once per day as a standard action, you can summon a movanic deva (Bestiary 2 p.28) to aid you. You gain telepathy with the movanic deva to a range of 100 feet. The deva follows your commands perfectly for

minute for every Hit Die you possess before vanishing back to its home. The deva doesn't follow commands that would cause it to violate its alignment by committing evil acts, and it could even attack you if the command is particularly egregious.
